newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares rose on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday with Audi shares up to $16.25 from $16.125 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares also up to $12.125 from $12.
Solidere A shares rose slightly to $10.75 from $10.625 on Monday while B shares fell to $11 from $11.125.
Turnover in BLC was 4,100 shares from 10,830. Volume of trade in Audi shares was 27,762 shares from 57,761 which included 21,630 shares traded in blocks outside the BSE.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 100,367 shares compared with 105,457 and value was $1,246,298.75 against $1,342,071.
The BLOM stock index fell slightly by 0.005 percent to 918.61.
